description: Who is out at one club right now, and its next National League game (next_game): each player with type, reason as the source published it, since when, the expected return, confidence and sources. By default only players counted as out; ask for categories to include healthy scratches or loans. For several clubs or the whole league, use search_absences instead: one call, not one per club.

categories.description: Which entries: "out" (default: injured, ill, suspended and other absences), "scratch" (fit, left out by the coach), "loan" (farm team or another club), or "all".

team.description: The club: its slug or its name ("EV Zug", "SCRJ Lakers"). The slugs: ajoie (HC Ajoie), ambri (HC Ambrì-Piotta), bern (SC Bern), biel (EHC Biel-Bienne), davos (HC Davos), fribourg (Fribourg-Gottéron), geneve (Genève-Servette HC), kloten (EHC Kloten), langnau (SCL Tigers), lausanne (Lausanne HC), lugano (HC Lugano), rapperswil (SCRJ Lakers), zsc (ZSC Lions), zug (EV Zug).
